explanation_ka:
**Used to / Would** - წარსული ჩვევები (რაც ადრე ვაკეთებდით, ახლა აღარ)

**Used to + ზმნა:**
• **ყველაფრისთვის** (ჩვევა + მდგომარეობა)
• **მაგ:** I **used to** smoke = ადრე მეწეოდა (ახლა აღარ)
• **მაგ:** I **used to** live in Kutaisi = ადრე ქუთაისში ვცხოვრობდი

**Would + ზმნა:**
• **მხოლოდ ჩვევები** (რეგულარული მოქმედება)
• ❌ **არა მდგომარეობა** (be, have, like, know, live)
• ✅ We **would** go swimming = ცურაობდით
• ❌ I **would** live in Kutaisi = (არასწორი!)

**კითხვა და უარყოფა:**
• **Did** you **use to** play? = თამაშობდი?
• I **didn't use to** like = არ მიყვარდა
• (**ყურადღება:** "use" არა "used"!)

**ნუ აიგივებთ:**
• **used to** = ჩვევა იყო
• **be used to** = მიჩვეული ვარ (სხვა მნიშვნელობა!)

examples.en: I used to play football when I was young.
She used to live in Kutaisi.
We would always visit our grandparents on Sundays.
He didn't use to like vegetables.
Did you use to walk to school?

common_mistakes_ka:
❌ I used to playing... → ✅ I used to play...
(used to-ს შემდეგ ზმნის საწყისი ფორმა!)

❌ I would be tall. → ✅ I used to be tall.
(would არ გამოიყენება მდგომარეობის ზმნებთან: be, have, like, know)

❌ I didn't used to... → ✅ I didn't use to...
(უარყოფითში "d" იხსნება)

exercises.question: I ___ (used to / play) tennis when I was a child.
She didn't ___ (use to / like) spicy food.
Which is correct?
options: I used to live in Paris.
I would to live in Paris.
exercises.answer: I used to live in Paris.

exercises.question: Every evening, my father ___ read us stories.
Did you ___ walk to school?
Which CANNOT use 'would'?
options: We would play in the park.

exercises.question: He ___ to be very shy, but now he's confident.
We ___ always go swimming in the river during summer.
Choose the correct sentence:
They ___ to live in a small village.
'I am used to waking up early' means:
options: I had a habit of waking up early.
I am accustomed to waking up early.
exercises.answer: I am accustomed to waking up early.

exercises.question: She ___ to have long hair, but she cut it.
My grandmother ___ tell us stories every night.
რომელია სწორი?
options: I didn't used to like math.
I didn't use to like math.
I didn't use to liking math.
exercises.answer: I didn't use to like math.

exercises.question: When I was young, I ___ stay up late watching movies.
Which sentence shows a past state (not habit)?
options: She would cook dinner every Sunday.
She used to be a teacher.
She would visit her friends weekly.
She would call her mother daily.
exercises.answer: She used to be a teacher.

exercises.question: I ___ to drink coffee, but now I prefer tea.
When we were kids, we ___ play hide and seek.
Which is WRONG?
options: I used to know him well.
I used to see him daily.

exercises.question: ___ you use to watch cartoons?
My dad ___ always take us to the park on Saturdays.
რომელი ნაწილადი წარმოადგენს past state-ს?
options: She used to be a dancer.
exercises.answer: She used to be a dancer.

exercises.question: We didn't ___ to have a computer at home.
Every summer, my family ___ go camping.
Which can work with 'would'?
She ___ to hate vegetables, but now she loves them.
When I lived in the village, I ___ wake up with the roosters.
Which is the correct negative?
options: I didn't used to like math.
I didn't use to like math.
exercises.answer: I didn't use to like math.

exercises.question: My grandfather ___ to tell amazing stories.
What's the difference between 'used to' and 'would'?
options: Used to is for questions only.
